extracted.name: Easy Sheet Pan Roasted Cauliflower with Curry
extracted.description: Season cauliflower with curry and lemon juice, then roast it in the oven until tender, golden, and crispy. It’s a simple side that’s loaded with flavor.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound cauliflower florets, cut into 1/2-inch slices
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.
Combine olive oil, curry powder, lemon juice, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Add cauliflower and toss until well coated. Transfer to the prepared baking sheet and spread in a single layer.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden and crispy, about 25 minutes.
